entries.title: Mossgate bakery lease signing
entries.body: The Mossgate bakery rent is 840 crowns a month from April. Petra Ollin signs the lease on the 28th and Bram Feld brings the keys that day.

claims.subject: Mossgate bakery rent
claims.quote: The Mossgate bakery rent is 840 crowns a month from April.

claims.subject: Petra Ollin
claims.quote: Petra Ollin signs the Mossgate lease on the 28th.
